Oppia
� �
Oppia is an open-source online learning platform that enables anyone to create and share interactive learning experiences called explorations. These explorations simulate a one-on-one tutoring experience, allowing learners to actively engage with content and receive immediate feedback.
Oppia’s mission is to provide free, high-quality education to learners who lack access to traditional educational resources.
🌍 What Oppia Offers
🎓 Interactive, conversation-based learning
🧮 Free lessons in mathematics (fractions, ratios, etc.)
🔬 Planned expansion into basic science and financial literacy
🌐 Fully open-source and community-driven
Explore live lessons here:
👉 https://www.oppia.org/fractions
🛠️ Tech Stack
Oppia is a large-scale production application built using:
Backend: Python (Google App Engine architecture)
Frontend: Angular (TypeScript)
Database: Google Cloud Datastore
Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform
Testing: Pytest, Jasmine, Karma
CI/CD: GitHub Actions

🧪 Testing & Quality Standards
Oppia follows strict quality standards:
All new features must include tests
Code must pass linting and CI checks
Clear, maintainable code is preferred over clever hacks
Before submitting a PR, ensure:
Copy code
Bash
python -m scripts.linters.run_all_linters
